title: Discover, Submit and Grow Your Vibe-Coded Game
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
A few weeks ago I was struggling to find a place where people could browse AI-assisted and vibe-coded games in one spot. Now VibeToplist has grown to 46 unique game listings and is attracting over 3,500 visitors every week, all interested in discovering new projects to play, follow and wishlist.

What I enjoy most is the variety. One minute you're looking at a polished RPG, the next you're playing a completely bizarre experiment someone built over a weekend.

If you're building your own game, don't miss out on a free listing. The site was built specifically to help vibe/AI-assisted projects get discovered and connect with players who are actively looking for new games within this new genre.

Curious to see where this whole movement is in a year from now as I strongly believe people will get used to vibe-coded games, and accept it for what it is.

There will be a point in time that a vibe-coded game is outperforming a triple A game.

https://vibetoplist.com
